snippet.title: [VKMT] Halo CE+ X (Original Xbox) Release Trailer
snippet.description:
DISCLAIMER: This video is legacy content from when the team was still the VKMT modding group. Digital Landmine LLC is not affiliated with Microsoft/Halo Studios and as such these uploads do not represent any project in development. Please understand we will not be able to answer any queries regarding these uploads. If you are looking for additional uploads from this period, refer to the channel playlists. 
Playlist Link: https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PL4w26TdmvKuIDib87Yf4wIKxUIulVWcf9&si=FDcQNfnmokEOUj5v

ORIGINAL DESCRIPTION:

GO BEYOND.
DOWNLOAD:
https://www.moddb.com/mods/halo-ce/downloads/halo-ce-x-original-xbox

The complete Xbox release of Halo CE+ is here! featuring 13 multiplayer maps, a new menu, bonus features and more.  This mod is for the original Xbox release of Halo Combat Evolved (NTSC) and is not compatible with MCC.

Halo CE+ X features the following maps:

- Magnitude
- Retribution
- Intensity
- Delta Ruined
- CO2
- Hektik
- Nitra
- Gothra
- Abyss
- Underground
- Fallout
- Fissure Fall
- Chiron TL35
